title: Songs of Praise

questions.question: You will say in that day: "I will give thanks to you, O LORD, for though you were angry with me, your anger turned away, that you might what me?"
Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and will not be what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 12:2 (ESV): "I will trust, and will not be afraid;"

questions.question: For the LORD GOD is my strength and my what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 12:2 (ESV): "the LORD GOD is my strength and my song,"

questions.question: With joy you will draw water from the wells of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 12:3 (ESV): "With joy you will draw water from the wells of salvation."

questions.question: Sing praises to the LORD, for he has done what?
And you will say in that day: "Give thanks to the LORD, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the whom?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 12:4 (ESV): "make known his deeds among the peoples,"

questions.question: Proclaim that his name is what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 12:4 (ESV): "proclaim that his name is exalted."

questions.question: Let this be made known in all the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 12:5 (ESV): "let this be made known in all the earth."

questions.question: Shout, and sing for joy, O inhabitant of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 12:6 (ESV): "Shout, and sing for joy, O inhabitant of Zion,"

questions.question: For great in your midst is the Holy One of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 12:6 (ESV): "For great in your midst is the Holy One of Israel."

questions.question: The chapter begins with the phrase "You will say in that day". What day does this refer to?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 12:1 (Contextual reference to the restoration described in Chapter 11).

questions.question: In verse 2, the phrase "The LORD GOD" combines which two names?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 12:2 (ESV footnote or Hebrew text: Yah Yahweh).

questions.question: Which other biblical song is "The LORD is my strength and my song, and he has become my salvation" found in?
Isaiah 12 is often considered a hymn of what?
From the "wells of salvation" implies a contrast to the waters of where mentioned earlier?

key_verse_text: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and will not be afraid; for the LORD GOD is my strength and my song, and he has become my salvation.
